nodes.name: Lay draft da duyet tu PostgreSQL

parameters.query:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT pj.id FROM publishing_jobs pj JOIN content_drafts cd ON cd.id = pj.draft_id
  WHERE pj.status = 'queued' AND cd.status = 'approved' AND cd.approved_at IS NOT NULL AND cd.reviewer IS NOT NULL
    AND (pj.scheduled_at IS NULL OR pj.scheduled_at <= now())
  ORDER BY pj.id FOR UPDATE OF pj SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 10
), claimed AS (
  UPDATE publishing_jobs pj SET status = 'publishing', claimed_at = now() FROM candidates c WHERE pj.id = c.id RETURNING pj.*
)
SELECT c.id AS publishing_job_id, c.draft_id, c.destination, c.idempotency_key, c.scheduled_at, c.attempts,
       cd.title, cd.body, cd.claims_json, cd.uncertainties_json, cd.safety_note, cd.source_url,
       cd.approved_at, cd.reviewer, cd.status AS draft_status
FROM claimed c JOIN content_drafts cd ON cd.id = c.draft_id
